description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You fail, but do not critically fail, a skill check with the chosen skill.

You have worked hard to become one of the greatest talents in a particular area, and your reputation simply wouldn't stand if you were seen failing. When you select this feat, choose a skill that you're a master in. You can reroll the triggering check, but you must use the new result, even if it's worse.

Special You can select this feat more than once, choosing a different skill each time. You can What, Me, Fail? once per hour for each skill you've chosen.
